patch_description:
This version combines exact-cost greedy construction, elite multi-start selection, local search, segment reversal, and destroy-and-repair large-neighborhood search.

1. It evaluates every greedy next-transaction choice using `workload.get_opt_seq_cost`, so choices are driven by actual conflict-induced makespan rather than operation counts.
2. It uses multiple shuffled starting transactions, retaining several elite schedules because greedy construction is path dependent.
3. It improves elite schedules using exact full-schedule relocation, distant swaps, and segment reversals.
4. It applies destroy-and-repair to move several transactions jointly across local minima. Each reinserted transaction and insertion position is evaluated using the exact simulator cost.
5. All evaluated schedules are cached, avoiding repeated simulator work during overlapping local-search neighborhoods.
6. Every returned schedule remains a permutation of all transaction indices and preserves the original input/output interface.
